## Description

Cache the built app files (script, style, fonts) with a service worker so a reload with no network shows the app shell and an offline state instead of a browser error. Static assets only: no API response, no patient data and no identifier is cached or stored. Deferred until pilot interviews say outages are a real problem.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** With the network off, reloading a page opened earlier today loads the app shell with the offline state and shows no patient data.
- [ ] **AC2.** Browser storage contains no patient identifiers (automated check that fails if one appears).
- [ ] **AC3.** A new deploy replaces the cached files (no stale shell after a release).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
